fields.title: AI-Powered Resume Analyzer
fields.description: Develop an AI-powered resume analyzer that allows users to upload their resumes and receive automated analysis. The system should extract important information such as skills, education, experience, and certifications. It should compare the resume with a selected job description and provide a match score along with suggestions for improvement. The application should have a responsive React frontend and Django backend with proper data storage and user-friendly results.
